about: The room, 1999: its sounds. Drawn by infra/room/synth.py; infra/room/sfx.py on the server makes the ElevenLabs version from "eleven" and the room plays that one where it exists. gain = loudness in the room.

sounds.name: amb-rain
sounds.what: Rain on the window glass and the sill
sounds.eleven: Steady night rain heard from inside a small old motel room, drops tapping on a single-pane window and a tin sill, water running down a gutter, distant city hiss, cosy and calm, no thunder, no music

sounds.name: amb-room
sounds.what: Room tone: mains hum, the tubes, an old fridge
sounds.eleven: Quiet room tone of a small old apartment at night, faint hum of CRT computer monitors and an old refrigerator behind the wall, very soft, steady, no music

sounds.name: amb-neon
sounds.eleven: Buzzing of an old neon motel sign heard through a closed window, electrical hum with an occasional stutter and flicker, quiet, no music

sounds.name: amb-street
sounds.what: A car now and then on the wet street below
sounds.eleven: Distant city street at night in the rain, heard from a third-floor room, an occasional car passing on wet asphalt, tyres hissing on water, far away, calm, no horns, no music

sounds.name: foghorn
sounds.what: A foghorn on the bay, far away
sounds.eleven: A single distant foghorn on San Francisco Bay at night, deep two-tone horn, heard far away through fog and rain, long reverb tail

sounds.name: radiator-1
sounds.eleven: Old cast-iron radiator ticking and knocking softly as it heats up, in a small quiet room, two or three metallic ticks

sounds.name: radiator-2
sounds.eleven: Old steam radiator giving a single soft clank and a short hiss, in a quiet room at night

sounds.name: thunder
sounds.eleven: Rolling thunder over a city at night heard from indoors through a window, a close crack then a long deep rumble fading away, rain continuing

sounds.name: purr
sounds.eleven: A content cat purring close up, soft and deep, for three seconds, quiet room

sounds.name: ring
sounds.eleven: A late-1990s beige office desk telephone ringing once, electronic warbling ring, in a small room

sounds.name: pager
sounds.what: The pager buzzes on the desk
sounds.eleven: A 1990s pager vibrating on a wooden desk, short buzz rattling against the wood, then a small beep

sounds.name: disk
sounds.when: click the PC, a command runs
sounds.eleven: Old 1990s computer hard disk drive seeking and crunching for one second, clicking heads, inside a beige tower PC

sounds.name: crt
sounds.eleven: A CRT monitor switching on, a degauss thunk and a rising high-pitched whine, static crackle

sounds.name: key-1
sounds.eleven: A single keypress on a heavy 1990s mechanical computer keyboard, clicky, close

sounds.name: key-4
sounds.eleven: Pressing the big Enter key on a heavy 1990s mechanical computer keyboard, a deep clack, close
